paragraphs: He is mentioned in Berakhot 27b: Abaye permitted him to fumigate baskets with sulfur.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Aramaic phrase is לכברויי סלי, fumigating baskets with sulfur. In the William Davidson digital text of Berakhot 27b, the permission is followed by “that was a mistake” and discussion of mistaken prayer times.

The saved Davidson Berakhot27b mention names Rav Dimi bar Livai and Abaye’s permission to fumigate baskets with sulfur. Two additional whole saved scalars were read: that was a mistake, followed by a cloudy-day prayer-time story concerning the end of Shabbat. They do not establish the older note’s specific Friday-after-nightfall description. That historical context claim is qualified; no surrounding ruling is imported into the notice.
